options.label: Annals
options.help: Keep the complete log of everything, searchable by the god.

options.label: Annals kept
options.help: Older months are deleted (0 = keep forever).

options.label: Deeds per mortal
options.help: How many dated deeds it remembers for each mortal.

options.label: Deeds in a dossier
options.help: Recent deeds it sees for a mortal involved in the moment.

options.label: Dossiers per thought
options.help: How many mortals get a full dossier in one thought.

options.label: Rename cooldown
options.help: How often it may take a new name.

options.label: Memory model
options.help: The light model that folds old memories into its chronicle.

options.label: Things it loves
options.help: How many likes a new god is born with.

options.label: Things it hates
options.help: How many dislikes a new god is born with.

options.label: Strikes remembered
options.help: How long a manipulation attempt counts against a mortal.

options.label: Favor per strike
options.help: Favor lost per attempt, scaled by its nature (0: none).

options.label: Command patience
options.help: Thoughts a binding command may stay unfinished before it is dropped.

options.label: Imposed mood lasts
options.help: How long a mood set from the God Manager lasts.

options.label: Sees the sky
options.help: It notices the moon and how long it has rained. What it feels about it is its own choice.

options.label: Memories return
options.help: In quiet moments one old memory that fits the present comes back to it.

options.label: Between memories
options.help: The least time between two memories coming back.
